- Fee: $53{,}493.12 \times 0.35\% = 187.23$ USD
- Total: $53{,}493.12 + 187.23 = 53{,}680.35$ USD

**Pay supplier in USD**
- Rate: $1.11 \times (1+2\%) = 1.1322$ USD/EUR
- Amount: $48{,}000 \times 1.1322 = 54{,}345.60$ USD
- Discount $0\%$: $54{,}345.60$ USD

The platform is cheapest at $53{,}680.35$ USD, vs bank $53{,}857.64$ and USD $54{,}345.60$.
